verdicts.reason: A keeps the can inside its circle, but the body copy is tiny and pushed against the left edge, so the banner reads body → image → headline. The GLACIER wordmark sits below the headline, and the CTA is the same size as the BACK BY DEMAND and SUMMER ONLY badges, so it doesn't stand out. B has all of A's problems, and its circle has also come away from the can: the circle now sits behind the body copy, so text runs over a graphic and the can floats on its own. That breaks the original's product graphic.
